title: Contiguous Array
description: Find the maximum length of a contiguous subarray with an equal number of 0s and 1s.
pseudocode:
1. let map = {0: -1}, count = 0, maxLen = 0
2. for i = 0 to nums.length - 1:
3.   count += (nums[i] == 1 ? 1 : -1)
4.   if map has count: maxLen = max(maxLen, i - map[count])
5.   else: map[count] = i

steps.note: Initialize map with 0: -1 to handle subarrays starting from index 0
Count -1 not in map, add it: map[-1] = 0
Count 0 exists in map (index -1): maxLen = max(0, 1 - (-1)) = 2
Count -1 exists in map (index 0): maxLen = max(2, 2 - 0) = 2
